title: Embedding preserves the scanned input symbol
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer, let $Q$ be a state set, let $\Sigma$ be a symbol alphabet, let $x$ be an input word over $\Sigma$, and let $c$ be a configuration with $k$ work tapes, state set $Q$, and input $x$. The optional symbol scanned by the input head of the embedded configuration equals the optional symbol scanned by the input head of $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration with $k$ work tapes, state set $Q$, and input $x$
replaced:
For any configuration $c$ of a machine with $k$ work tapes, the input symbol
scanned in the embedding of $c$ into the $(k+1)$-tape oracle model equals the
input symbol scanned in $c$.
